# MrCakes931 Agent Intelligence Ecosystem

> A 32-repository, security-first ecosystem for agent interoperability, discovery, trust, hybrid swarms, intelligence workflows, and conformance. AIX is an extension layer over established standards, not a replacement for them.

This repository is the public ecosystem control plane. It owns the authoritative repository registry, dependency graph, architecture decisions, governance, and portfolio status. Individual repositories own their implementations.

## Start here
- [Master README](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/README.md): purpose, architecture, build and current portfolio maturity.
- [AI agent instructions](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/AGENTS.md): safe contribution and verification rules.
- [32-repository status](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/PORTFOLIO-STATUS.md): existence, maturity, priority, importance and next gates.
- [Public agent catalog](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/public-agent-catalog.json): machine-readable index of all 31 public repositories, including existence and discovery entry points.
- [Canonical repository registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/repositories.json): machine-readable inventory and dependency declarations.
- [Implementation status](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/implementation-status.json): evidence-based maturity and verification status.
- [Dependency graph](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/dependencies.json): cross-repository relationships.
- [AI discoverability contract](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/docs/AI-DISCOVERABILITY.md): llms.txt, agent instructions, metadata, MCP, A2A and security.
- [GitHub About metadata](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/docs/GITHUB-REPOSITORY-ABOUT-METADATA.md): individualized descriptions and topic sets for existing public repositories.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Existing public portfolio repositories

There are currently 23 existing public portfolio repositories. Existence does not imply production maturity.

### Control plane and ecosystem-facing
- [agent-intelligence-ecosystem](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem): canonical registry, governance, architecture and dependency control plane.
- [agent-ai-discovery](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-ai-discovery): machine-readable discovery documents and deterministic capability indexes.
- [mrcakes931-ecosystem](https://github.com/PCakes303/mrcakes931-ecosystem): human onboarding, architecture guide and ecosystem navigation.
- [agent-ecosystem-integration](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-ecosystem-integration): protocol integration profiles and adapter safety contracts.

### Foundation and security
- [agent-foundation-spec](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-foundation-spec): normative foundation requirements and invariants.
- [agent-resource-manifest](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-resource-manifest): portable agent resource manifests and permission declarations.
- [agent-schema-registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-schema-registry): versioned machine-readable schemas and compatibility governance.
- [agent-identity-trust](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-identity-trust): identity, authentication context, delegation and trust contracts.
- [agent-secure-supply-chain](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-secure-supply-chain): artifact records, SBOM references and provenance metadata.
- [agent-policy-engine](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-policy-engine): deterministic default-deny policy decision evaluator; not a production enforcement boundary.
- [agent-audit-provenance](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-audit-provenance): audit event schema and SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL reference tooling.

### AIX and transport
- [aix-core](https://github.com/PCakes303/aix-core): experimental semantic interoperability envelope and schema, extending established protocols.
- [aix-codecs](https://github.com/PCakes303/aix-codecs): RFC 8785 canonical JSON encoding and strict decoding for AIX messages.
- [agent-transport-gateway](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-transport-gateway): experimental transport-neutral request guard for AIX over HTTP, MCP and A2A.
- [agent-discovery-network](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-discovery-network): trust-filtered index for expiring agent, resource and service advertisements.
- [agent-capability-registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-capability-registry): bounded catalog and advisory matching of declared agent capabilities.

### Hybrid swarm
- [swarm-runtime](https://github.com/PCakes303/swarm-runtime): bounded worker supervisor and adapter contract; not a sandbox.
- [swarm-coordination](https://github.com/PCakes303/swarm-coordination): task delegation, acknowledgement, idempotency, bounded retries and lease recovery.
- [swarm-state-mesh](https://github.com/PCakes303/swarm-state-mesh): versioned task state events, optimistic revisions and opaque context references.

### Intelligence
- [osint-source-registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/osint-source-registry): review-gated source metadata catalog; no collection or crawling client.
- [intelligence-knowledge-graph](https://github.com/PCakes303/intelligence-knowledge-graph): experimental provenance-aware graph model for source, evidence, entity and relationship records.

### Adoption and tooling
- [agent-tool-adapters](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-tool-adapters): experimental Python adapter registry with explicit capabilities, policy-gated invocation and bounded JSON payloads; no bundled third-party adapters or sandbox runtime.
- [agent-skill-library](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-skill-library): experimental declarative skill package and workflow schema with strict local validation; no workflow execution, publisher trust or policy enforcement.

## Planned public repositories

Six approved public portfolio repositories remain to be created:
- [osint-collection-framework](https://github.com/PCakes303/osint-collection-framework): authorized, policy-checked collection with reproducible logs.
- [osint-evidence-engine](https://github.com/PCakes303/osint-evidence-engine): immutable evidence records, hashes, provenance and transformation history.
- [osint-entity-resolution](https://github.com/PCakes303/osint-entity-resolution): ambiguity-aware entity correlation with calibrated confidence and human review.
- [agent-skill-library](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-skill-library): versioned, discoverable and policy-bound reusable workflows.
- [agent-sandbox-security](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-sandbox-security): enforced isolation and resource boundaries for untrusted workloads.
- [agent-conformance-lab](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-conformance-lab): executable protocol, compatibility and security conformance tests.
- [agent-federation-network](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-federation-network): trust-aware federation between independently operated agent networks.

These links are roadmap identifiers, not claims that the repositories already exist. The private operations repository is excluded from this public catalog and from all public synchronization.

## Architecture and status
- Portfolio: 30 repositories total; 29 public and 1 private.
- Latest account audit: 22 existing public portfolio repositories, 7 public repositories not yet created, and 1 existing private operations repository.
- The separate `PCakes303/PCakes303` profile repository is excluded from the 30-repository portfolio.
- Public discovery excludes private operational content.
- Maturity is repository-specific. Consult the status tracker and repository-local tests/CI before claiming a feature is implemented.
- AIX approach: extension/interoperability layer over existing standards.
- Swarm approach: hybrid centralized, federated and peer-to-peer architecture.
- Licensing: mixed, selected per repository and artifact; license decisions remain pending where not yet approved.

## Agent integration
- Read each repository's `AGENTS.md` before proposing code changes.
- Use the canonical JSON registry and schemas rather than scraping prose where possible.
- MCP tools, when published, will be read-only by default and limited to public, validated resources.
- A2A Agent Cards will be published only for deployed agent services with a real endpoint and verified capabilities. A repository metadata file is not itself a live A2A service.
- Discovery metadata never grants trust, authorization, execution permission or access to private repositories.

## Build and validate
```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python tools/starter_build.py
```
